title.en: The World represented in the grammar both ways, its amounts not
title.zh: 世界于文法中两向得表示，其数量则否

statement.en: The World's relations are a model of the grammar both ways: every re-identification is a correspondence of its name-free part, and every relational part is some world's. Its amounts are not: the model does not determine standings, and balance is carried only by conservation's step.
statement.zh: 世界之关系两向为文法之模型：每一重认为其无名部分之一一对应，每一关系部分为某世界者。其数量则否：模型不定站位，平衡唯由守恒之步所载。

laws.en: A one-to-one correspondence of carriers («一一对应», with its inverse and composite) carries R to R' where the image of R along it is R' («谓» («像» e.to R) R'), exactly where two things are related exactly where their images are («对应之像»); read back and pointwise, the inverse carries back, composites carry the composite, and every relation on the second carrier is the image of what it reads back.
laws.zh: 一一对应（«一一对应»，及其逆与合成）携 R 至 R'，当 R 沿之之像为 R'（«谓» («像» e.to R) R'），恰当二者相关恰当其像相关（«对应之像»）；逐点与回读之，逆对应携回，合成携合成，第二载体上每一关系为其回读者之像。

laws.en: Carrying is kept by the grammar's operations, the meet, the converse, composition and reach («合之像», «逆之像», «而之像», «及之像»), and inclusion is kept («则之对应»); identity and the one are carried («静之像», «一之像»), and a predicate is carried as its partial identity «合» «静» (fun x _ => P x) where it holds exactly where it holds at the image («部分恒等之像»).
laws.zh: 携为文法之运算所保：合、逆、而、及（«合之像»、«逆之像»、«而之像»、«及之像»），含亦保（«则之对应»）；静与一被携（«静之像»、«一之像»），谓词以其部分恒等 «合» «静» (fun x _ => P x) 被携，当其恰于像处成立（«部分恒等之像»）。

laws.en: The continuation family is kept: a correspondence carrying 缘 and the class carries reach, continuation, lines, reach on a line, closure and families, having a condition or a consequence, beginning, ending, abiding, alteration (with the finer class), renewal and going on without end, each at x exactly where at e.to x (and the nine more of the family).
laws.zh: 续之族为所保：携缘与类之一一对应携及、续、相续、所及、所闭、同族、有前、有后、生、亡、住、异（携细类）、复生、不穷，各于 x 恰当于 e.to x。

laws.en: Being a class, acyclicity and constancy are kept both ways, and the core is kept at every pair: forward through the image of the witnessing relation, back through the relation it reads back («类之对应», «无环之对应», «有常之对应», «核之对应»).
laws.zh: 为类、无环与有常两向皆保，核于每一对皆保：前向经见证关系之像，回向经其回读之关系（«类之对应»、«无环之对应»、«有常之对应»、«核之对应»）。

laws.en: The map's terms are kept: carrying renewal, a carrying renewal within reach, generation and keeping in the strong form, and reaching an end («传之对应», «所及有传之对应», «全生成之对应», «全守之对应», «有终之对应»).
laws.zh: 图之诸项为所保：传、所及中有传、全生成、全守、有终（«传之对应»、«所及有传之对应»、«全生成之对应»、«全守之对应»、«有终之对应»）。

laws.en: Ending on every branch is pulled back along any map carrying continuation from a region closed under it into continuation of another model, with no inverse («尽之拉回»); its keeping by a correspondence is two cases of it («尽之对应»).
laws.zh: 处处终尽沿任一自闭区携续入他模型之续之映射拉回，无需逆（«尽之拉回»）；其为一一对应所保即其二例（«尽之对应»）。

laws.en: The occurrence model's name-free part: the class of being at the same step, conservation's step, a relation within each step, and the partial identity of a predicate (Web.sameStep, World.conservationStep, World.withinStep, Web.partialIdentity); the names' step is the step along the names' continuation (Steps.along_iff_itself).
laws.zh: 出现模型之无名部分：同步之类、守恒之步、一步之内之关系、谓词之部分恒等（Web.sameStep、World.conservationStep、World.withinStep、Web.partialIdentity）；名之步即沿名之续之步（Steps.along_iff_itself）。

laws.en: A later step, and the same step or later, are read at the model along the names and across by the same step (Steps.later_iff, Steps.sameOrLater_iff); so arising and ceasing recurring are statements at the model through the names' step, each with the conjunct that an occurrence exists (World.arisingRecurs_iff, World.ceasingRecurs_iff).
laws.zh: 较晚之步与同步或较晚，于模型上沿名并经同步读之（Steps.later_iff、Steps.sameOrLater_iff）；故生之屡与亡之屡经名之步为模型上之陈述，各带有一出现之合取（World.arisingRecurs_iff、World.ceasingRecurs_iff）。

laws.en: Every re-identification is a one-to-one correspondence of the relata at each step and of the occurrences, carrying the name-free part's ten relations: the same-step class, conservation's step (its conservation is the carried one), activity, standing and presence as partial identities, and five relations within a step; so beginning under conservation is fixed (World.reidentify_carries and nine more).
laws.zh: 每一重认为每步关系项与诸出现之一一对应，携无名部分之十关系：同步之类、守恒之步（其守恒即所携者）、活动站位与在场为部分恒等、一步之内五关系；故守恒下之生为所定（World.reidentify_carries 等十律）。

laws.en: The relational part ranges over everything: any activity, requiring, drawing and presence is some world's, with no amount, and at the model any predicate's partial identity, two relations lying within a step and presence lists are the relational part of a world's model (World.ofRelations, World.ofModel and their lemmas).
laws.zh: 关系部分遍及一切：任一活动、所需、所取与在场为某世界者，无数量；于模型上，任一谓词之部分恒等、二在一步之内之关系与在场之列，为某世界模型之关系部分（World.ofRelations、World.ofModel 及其引理）。

laws.en: Conservation is exactly a relation 'f's standing after the step with b is a': every world's has this form by definition, and every such relation is some world's, one relatum exchanging (World.conserves_form, World.ofConservationForm_conserves); through one conserving pair it is labelled by standings after the step, so difunctional (World.conserves_iff_same_level, World.conserves_difunctional).
laws.zh: 守恒恰为「f 步后之站位加 b 为 a」之关系：每一世界之守恒依定义有此形，每一此等关系为某世界者，一关系项交换（World.conserves_form、World.ofConservationForm_conserves）；经一守恒之对，其为步后站位所标，故为双函数（World.conserves_iff_same_level 等）。

laws.en: What amounts induce is decided: conservation, a need met, giving, taking, standing and falling; on one relatum, conservation is a proposition Q across every step exactly where Q is decided, a lemma of whole-number equations (compare indicates_iff_decided); and that every world decides its activity is exactly excluded middle (World.amounts_decided and three more).
laws.zh: 数量所引者皆可判定：守恒、所需得足、予、取、站位与落；于一关系项上，守恒于每步为命题 Q 恰当 Q 可判定，自然数等式之引理（参 indicates_iff_decided）；每一世界判定其活动恰为排中律（World.amounts_decided 等四律）。

laws.en: F1, standings not determined: two worlds standing at positive k and k', with nothing exchanged, agree at every step on each field the model's selection reads (activity, standing, requiring, drawing, presence, a need met, giving, taking, conservation, falling), while their standings are k and k' (World.standingAt_alike).
laws.zh: F1，站位不为所定：二世界站位于正之 k 与 k'，无所交换，于每步在模型所选读之每一域上皆合（活动、站位、所需、所取、在场、所需得足、予、取、守恒、落），而其站位为 k 与 k'（World.standingAt_alike）。

laws.en: F1′, balance not determined by the web and the signs of exchange: no property of a world's web and its signs of exchange (who is present, who gives to and takes from whom) that keeps to the signs' agreement is balance; the idle world balances and its double, giving itself two units, does not (World.balance_needs_conservation and five more).
laws.zh: F1′，网与交换之号不定平衡：世界之网与其交换之号（谁在场、谁予谁、谁取于谁）之任何守号之合之性质皆非平衡；闲世界平衡，其倍（自予二单位）则否（World.balance_needs_conservation 等六）。

laws.en: F2, identity not induced: where conservation across a step is identity, the standings after it tell every two relata apart, and no map of the predicates on Nat into Nat is one to one (from Diagonal.claims_incomplete), so on the predicates of Nat conservation is never identity (World.not_conserves_identity and two more).
laws.zh: F2，同一不由数量所引：守恒于一步为同一处，步后站位分辨每二关系项；Nat 之谓词入 Nat 之映射皆非单射（由 Diagonal.claims_incomplete），故于 Nat 之谓词上守恒永非同一（World.not_conserves_identity 等三）。

laws.en: F3, a line of falls ends: along the names it ends on every branch, from the amounts' law of falls ending at whole numbers (Amounts.falls_end) through «尽之拉回», so it does not go on without end and no world with a relatum falls at every occurrence; a line under a class holding everywhere goes on without end, so this is a condition of the image (World.falls_exhaust and three more).
laws.zh: F3，落之线终尽：沿名处处终尽，由整数上落终之律（Amounts.falls_end）经 «尽之拉回»，故不不穷，有关系项之世界无处处皆落者；处处成立之类下之线不穷，故此为像之条件（World.falls_exhaust 等四）。

hypotheses.en: The World's modelling commitments: discrete steps with one shared index, the same relata at every step, whole-number amounts, Prop-valued activity, requiring and drawing, and equality on relata.
hypotheses.zh: 世界之建模所承：离散之步共一指标，每步同一关系项，整数数量，活动、所需、所取为命题值，关系项上之相等。

hypotheses.en: The name-free part is a stated selection: amounts read only by sign, against a need and in conservation's equation, the index only through the same-step class and the steps' own 缘; a re-identification carries more, such as a standing's value or the step order.
hypotheses.zh: 无名部分为明言之选：数量唯以号、对所需与守恒之式读之，指标唯经同步之类与诸步自身之缘；重认所携者更多，如站位之值或步之序。

hypotheses.en: The forward direction is a schema of instance theorems; transport is shown for the terms listed in GrammarTransport, each with the relations it reads carried.
hypotheses.zh: 前向为实例定理之格式；搬运仅于 GrammarTransport 所列诸项示之，各带其所读关系之携。

does_not_show.en: That amounts are represented: the model does not determine a world's standings, so a world is not recovered from its model.
does_not_show.zh: 数量得表示：模型不定世界之站位，故世界不能自其模型复得。

does_not_show.en: That balance is derived: at the occurrence model only conservation's step carries it, defined from the balance equation; unit pairings and an idle added relatum are near-definitional too; F1′ reads the web and signs only.
does_not_show.zh: 平衡得推出：于出现模型唯守恒之步载之，其由平衡式定义；单位之配对与闲之增项亦近乎定义；F1′ 只读网与号。

does_not_show.en: The amount part's image beyond conservation alone: its form is exact taken alone, with one relatum present; the joint image with presence, falls and the other relations is open.
does_not_show.zh: 守恒之外数量部分之像：其形单独取之为确，一关系项在场；与在场、落及他关系之共像未决。

does_not_show.en: Anything beyond whole amounts: decidedness comes from their equations; F2 gives not identity, not two relata standing alike; F3 runs along one relatum's line, on the least loss one, not settling rest as no endless fall.
does_not_show.zh: 整数数量之外之事：可判定出于其等式；F2 给出非同一，非二关系项站位相同；F3 沿一关系项之线、依最小损一，未定止即无无穷之落。

does_not_show.en: That a world leaves its activity undecided: none can be shown to (not_not_decided); what holds is that every world deciding it is exactly excluded middle, activity being Prop-valued, a modelling choice.
does_not_show.zh: 某世界之活动不可判定：无可示者（not_not_decided）；成立者为每一世界判定之恰为排中律，活动为命题值，乃建模之选。

does_not_show.en: A forward theorem: no statement says every World notion is a grammar term, and that keeping to correspondences gives a term is not stated, the embedding having no syntax of terms.
does_not_show.zh: 前向之定理：无陈述言每一世界之概念为文法之项；守对应即给出项亦未陈述，因嵌入无项之语法。

does_not_show.en: Re-identification beyond the ten relations and the class of activity: that the names' step is carried only by renamings the same at every step, and the faithful but not full reading, are not in Lean.
does_not_show.zh: 十关系与活动之类之外之重认：名之步唯为每步同之重名所携，及忠实而非满之读，皆未入 Lean。

does_not_show.en: A representation through the order of joined exchanges; whether the descent laws follow from F3; interpretation with Lean; the grammar's terms not listed in GrammarTransport. Processes are represented in processes-represented-both-ways.
does_not_show.zh: 经相接交换之序之表示；降律是否由 F3 推出；与 Lean 之互译；GrammarTransport 未列之文法诸项。过程之表示见 processes-represented-both-ways。

detail.en: Two worlds of one relatum, never active, standing at 1 and at 2 throughout with nothing exchanged, agree on every field the model reads (World.standingAt_alike): the model does not determine standings.
detail.zh: 二一关系项之世界，从不活动，始终站位于 1 与 2，无所交换，于模型所读之每一域上皆合（World.standingAt_alike）：模型不定站位。

detail.en: The idle world, one relatum never active and standing at the number of steps, gives itself one unit a step and balances; giving itself two it does not, with the same web and signs of exchange (World.balance_needs_conservation).
detail.zh: 闲世界，一关系项从不活动、站位于步数，每步自予一单位而平衡；自予二单位则否，网与交换之号皆同（World.balance_needs_conservation）。

detail.en: On the predicates of Nat as relata, conservation across a step is identity in no world (World.not_conserves_identity).
detail.zh: 以 Nat 之谓词为关系项，任何世界于一步之守恒皆非同一（World.not_conserves_identity）。

detail.en: The model of one relatum's line of steps under the class of a predicate holding everywhere goes on without end, while no world's line of falls does (Steps.along_endless, World.falls_not_endless).
detail.zh: 一关系项之步线于处处成立之谓词之类下之模型不穷，而无世界之落之线如此（Steps.along_endless、World.falls_not_endless）。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty: GrammarTransport imports GrammarLaws, WorldRepresentation imports ContinuedClasses, Decidedness, Diagonal and GrammarTransport; both compile with the whole package and no name clash. Modelling choices: the World's own; the witnesses are single small worlds; every result is pointwise, with no function extensionality.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空：GrammarTransport 引 GrammarLaws，WorldRepresentation 引 ContinuedClasses、Decidedness、Diagonal 与 GrammarTransport；二者与全包同编译，无名冲突。建模之选为世界自身者；诸例皆单一小世界；皆逐点，不用函数外延性。

next_delta.en: The amount part's joint image; a representation through the order of joined exchanges; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 数量部分之共像；经相接交换之序之表示；人之审查。

correspondence.en: That definable properties are kept by isomorphisms of structures is standard model theory; here it is shown term by term, since the grammar is embedded with no syntax of terms. Difunctional relations are Riguet's (1948). The no-injection lemma is the constructive form of Cantor's theorem for a powerset, through the package's diagonal lemma (Lawvere 1969 states the general form). That conservation is labelled by standings is the cancellation of a whole-number equation. The representation is an interpretation of the World into grammar models, faithful on re-identifications and not injective on amounts. Graded in WRT's DESIGN.md.
correspondence.zh: 可定义之性质为结构同构所保，为标准模型论；此处逐项示之，因文法之嵌入无项之语法。双函数关系为 Riguet（1948）所立。无单射之引理为幂集 Cantor 定理之构造形，经本包之对角引理（Lawvere 1969 述其一般形）。守恒为站位所标，即整数等式之消去。此表示为世界入文法模型之诠释，于重认忠实，于数量非单射。分级见 WRT 之 DESIGN.md。

detail.en: The grammar's continuation family, Steps.along, Web.activityClass, Web.continuationStep and the instance theorems Web.unceasing_iff_late_beginnings and Web.ceases_iff_wang.
detail.zh: 文法之续之族、Steps.along、Web.activityClass、Web.continuationStep 及实例定理 Web.unceasing_iff_late_beginnings 与 Web.ceases_iff_wang。

detail.en: Reidentify, World.reidentify, World.Conserves, reidentify_taken and reidentify_given, Reidentify.mem_map and World.balanced_iff_conserves.
Web.itself, the names' continuation, and Reidentify.carry.
«像», «闭» and «所闭», and Amounts.falls_end, the amounts' law of falls ending.
detail.zh: «像»、«闭» 与 «所闭»，及数量落终之律 Amounts.falls_end。

detail.en: Amounts.whole_within: in whole numbers every stock lies within its count of least losses.
detail.zh: Amounts.whole_within：整数中每一存量在其最小损之数之内。

detail.en: The map's terms: «所及», «尽», «尽则非不穷», «传», «全生成», «全守» and «有终».
detail.zh: 图之诸项：«所及»、«尽»、«尽则非不穷»、«传»、«全生成»、«全守» 与 «有终»。

detail.en: Decided, a proposition holding or failing.
World.idle and World.idle_world, the idle world, and Flow.still.
detail.zh: 闲世界 World.idle 与 World.idle_world，及 Flow.still。

detail.en: World.of, the world with given relata, flow and web.
detail.zh: World.of：给定关系项、流与网之世界。

detail.en: The interleavings are one aspect of the World's representation: the occurrence model reads the shared index, which a world's reorderings change while keeping the order of joined exchanges.
detail.zh: 交错为世界之表示之一面：出现模型读共指标，世界之重排改之而守相接交换之序。

detail.en: Processes are represented in the grammar both ways by their moves' relations, faithful up to correspondence with the move inside and both classes; the World's representation reads its terms through the same GrammarTransport.
detail.zh: 过程以其诸着之关系于文法中两向得表示，着在其内携二类则于对应下忠实；世界之表示经同一 GrammarTransport 读其诸项。

history.en: 29 October 2026: added (WRT2), the World represented in the grammar both ways, its amounts not: the occurrence model and its name-free part, carried by every re-identification; the grammar's listed terms kept by correspondence; recurrence at the model; the relational part ranging over everything, conservation exactly its form, what amounts induce decided; the failure on amounts with four witnesses; after the design's two reviews, a review of the Lean and its re-read; study section 440.
history.zh: 2026年10月29日：新增（WRT2），世界于文法中两向得表示，其数量则否：出现模型及其无名部分，为每一重认所携；文法所列诸项为对应所保；模型上之屡；关系部分遍及一切，守恒恰为其形，数量所引者可判定；数量处之不成及其四例；经设计之二审、Lean 之审及其复读；研究第 440 节。

history.en: 29 October 2026 (WRP2, study section 447): its item and next step on processes brought to the landed theorem, processes-represented-both-ways, as a related record; no statement, law or declaration changed.
history.zh: 2026年10月29日（WRP2，研究第 447 节）：其言过程之项与下一步归于已成之定理 processes-represented-both-ways，列为相关；陈述、律与声明皆不改。

history.en: 30 October 2026 (U2, study section 461): the next step's item on the laws reading only activity at the occurrence model dropped: OU3f landed them at the web's carrier, which its audit (part (a)) shows needs no occurrence model; no statement, law or declaration changed.
history.zh: 2026年10月30日（U2，研究第 461 节）：下一步中于出现模型上唯读活动之诸律一项删去：OU3f 已于网之载体上证之，其审计（(a) 部分）示其无需出现模型；陈述、律与声明皆不改。
